item.title: How much does the British Royal Family cost taxpayers? King Charles' £137.9m grant, William's wealth
item.description: The British Royal Family receives £137.9 million through the Sovereign Grant in 2026/27, but a new bill proposes reducing the funding to £99.9 million the following year. Meanwhile, reports reveal Prince William’s £1.2 billion Duchy of Cornwall valuation and King Charles’ estimated £640 million fortune, raising questions about royal wealth, income and taxes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 100 days adrift in the Pacific Ocean: Nine leave Micronesia by boat; 5 survive, 4 die in Kiribati
item.description: Nine family members from Micronesia set out on what was supposed to be a one-hour boat journey to collect supplies. A storm swept their vessel off course, leaving them adrift in the Pacific Ocean for nearly 100 days. They eventually reached Kiribati, more than 3,000 miles away, but only five survived the ordeal.

item.title: Iran ramps up threats against US, removes cap on ballistic missile range
item.description: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps announced the removal of missile range restrictions while preparing for asymmetric warfare. This statement follows limited US strikes targeting Iranian anti-aircraft systems in the region. Reports indicated that explosions in Qeshm Island were due to Iranian air defense exercises and not hostile actions. US officials claim the Iranian air defense systems were severely weakened during previous conflicts.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Florida court upholds wife's protection order after husband turns up unannounced over Ferrari
item.description: A Florida appeals court upheld a domestic violence protection order against a husband who visited his estranged wife's condo asking about his Ferrari. Although video evidence did not support her account of the visit, three earlier incidents of physical violence provided grounds for the order.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: TikTok accused of becoming a gateway to the online sex industry for young girls
item.description: TikTok faces accusations of inadvertently promoting an online sex industry targeting young women and girls. Recent research highlights how popular OnlyFans creators use subtle cues in TikTok videos. These performers appear to endorse financial independence through selling adult content while circumventing platform restrictions. Additionally, TikTok's algorithm contributes to the circulation of these videos among teenagers. Advocates call for stricter regulations to protect minors from adult content influences across social media.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: Meet Pooja Verma, who built bird boxes that photograph nesting birds every three minutes
item.description: California student Pooja Verma has won first place in the 36th ‘A Voice for Animals’ contest for developing solar-powered bird boxes with cameras that photograph nesting birds every three minutes. Her nonprofit, Eco Innovate, has distributed the boxes to 10 schools and plans to expand the project across California and the US.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: ‘My family, I face threat’: Italy minister says his private data leaked on dark web
item.description: Antonio Tajani, Italy's foreign minister, revealed that his personal information is being circulated by cybercriminals on the dark web. This alarming situation has led to threats against him and his family. Tajani indicated these criminals are seeking more personal details. However, he remains resolute in enhancing security collaboration and reaffirmed Italy's steadfast support for Ukraine despite these ongoing threats.
item.dc:creator: Rajeev Singh

item.title: Earth has a new mini-moon: Tiny asteroid 2026 QQ8 was captured in April, spotted in August and will leave by early 2027
item.description: A minor asteroid, known as 2026 QQ8, found its way into Earth's gravity in April 2026. Observed for the first time in August, astronomers identified it as a natural celestial body. This mini-moon will remain within our orbit for approximately eight to nine months before departing. Its nearest approach is calculated to be 568,000 kilometers away, carrying no threat of impact as it joins the transient mini-moon collection around Earth.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Malaysia's king warns against challenging Najib Razak's house-arrest pardon after $12 million fine paid
item.description: Sultan Ibrahim of Malaysia has cautioned against any attempts to contest the conditional pardon granted to Najib Razak for house arrest. The process of Najib's transfer from prison has stalled as authorities seek legal clarification on the pardon’s implications. The attorney-general emphasized that the goal is merely to address legal uncertainties, not to challenge the King's directive.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Remote lighthouse island for sale for $6.9 million
item.description: Henry Island, located off the coast of Nova Scotia, has been a private retreat for over three decades. William F. Baker and Jeannemarie Gelin-Baker purchased the island in 1991, which features a lighthouse and a renovated house. They are now selling the property for C$6.99 million, wanting to pass it on to new owners. The couple's family lives in different parts of the world, making visits more difficult.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: US woman slams judge over 8.5-year sentence for man who stabbed her 22 times
item.description: Kaitlynn Berman, a New York woman, criticized the eight-and-a-half-year sentence given to her attacker. She emphasized that the punishment did not reflect the severity of her injuries. Judge Lewis acknowledged the attack's lasting impact on Berman's life during sentencing. Berman believes the focus should be on the consequences of criminal actions rather than the opportunity for rehabilitation.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: 'Downed 260 aircraft, new capabilities will astonish enemies': Iran warns US
item.description: Iran's military claimed it downed 260 hostile aircraft, including various fighter jets and drones during its conflict with the US. Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi stated that Iran has developed underground missile production facilities for enhanced defense capabilities. The Iranian defense network has rapidly advanced amid ongoing hostilities with the US and its allies. US President Donald Trump downplayed the situation, emphasizing no casualties occurred during the conflict.
item.dc:creator: Pranjal Pandey

item.title: Kelly Clarkson to headline Miami charity gala as organisation celebrates $50 million raised and 9,000 wishes granted
item.description: Kelly Clarkson is scheduled to perform at the 31st annual InterContinental Miami Make-A-Wish Ball in November 2026. The event will feature a reception, dinner, and silent auction to raise funds. Over the past 30 years, more than $50 million has been raised to grant wishes for children with critical illnesses. The gala's theme this year is Crystal Castle, which promises a magical experience for attendees.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
